properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign and verify JWT access tokens.

properties.name: google.redirect.uri
properties.description: Google OAuth callback URL handled by this backend.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Base URL of the Next.js frontend (redirects and Stripe return URLs).

properties.name: cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary cloud name for image uploads.

properties.name: stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Blank disables payment endpoints.

properties.name: stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Signing secret (whsec_...) of the Stripe webhook endpoint.

properties.name: promptpay.id
properties.description: Shop PromptPay ID (10-digit mobile, 13-digit citizen/tax ID or 15-digit e-wallet) for POS and admin-confirmed transfers.

properties.name: promptpay.account-name
properties.description: Account name shown to customers next to the transfer QR. Optional.
